titulo: [verb] + tanto / tanta / tantos / tantas + noun + que = so much / many... that...
subtitulo: Había tanta gente que no pudimos entrar.
regla: Verb + tanto/a/os/as + noun + que = so much / so many... that...: cause, then result. Tanto agrees with the noun. Don't confuse it with tanto... como (as much / many as).

bloques.texto: **Tanto** works as an adjective here, so it **agrees** with the noun: **tanto calor**, **tanta comida**, **tantos trabajadores**, **tantas veces**.
Cause first, result after **que**. The order can't be flipped.
Don't confuse it with **tanto... como** (_as much / many... as_).
Tip: **tan** + adjective, **tanto** + noun, and the noun picks the ending.

lista.es: ¡Tengo ==tanto calor que== me voy a desmayar!
lista.en: I'm so hot I'm going to faint!

lista.es: Hacen ==tanta comida== en Navidad ==que== tienen sobras para dos semanas.
lista.en: They make so much food at Christmas that they have leftovers for two weeks.

lista.es: Corrieron a ==tantos trabajadores que== hay protestas en las calles.
lista.en: They fired so many workers that there are protests in the streets.

lista.es: Lo voy a llamar ==tantas veces que== va a decir que soy un latoso.
lista.en: I'm going to call him so many times he'll say I'm a pest.

lista.es: Tiene ==tanto dinero que== no sabe en qué gastarlo.
lista.en: He has so much money he doesn't know what to spend it on.

lista.es: Había ==tanta gente que== no pudimos entrar.
lista.en: There were so many people that we couldn't get in.

bloques.texto: With no noun, **tanto** goes after the verb and doesn't change: **Comí tanto que me dolía la panza.** (_I ate so much my stomach hurt._)

filas.t: Tiene tantos libros como no caben.
Tiene tantos libros que no caben.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I have so much work that I can't go out._
lista.r: Tengo tanto trabajo que no puedo salir.

lista.p: Complete: _Tenía ___ sed que se tomó dos litros de agua._
